root_cause: The radios component only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven change events, causing the conditional content to remain visible when navigating away via arrow keys.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener that invokes the same attribute-update logic used for clicks, ensuring that selecting a radio via keyboard updates aria-expanded and toggles the associated conditional panel.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate the radio group with arrow keys and see conditional fields show/hide appropriately, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate handling if both click and change fire for the same interaction (e.g., mouse click may trigger both); however setAttributes is idempotent.
Slight performance overhead from iterating all radios on each change, but negligible given typical small radio groups.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrowing between options updates aria-expanded and hides/shows conditionals correctly.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work as before.
Verify that form data reflects the selected value after keyboard navigation.
Verify no regression in existing tests for the radios component.
